scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @cupidilla/contracts" "npm run dev -w @cupidilla/api" "npm run dev -w @cupidilla/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @cupidilla/api && npm run build -w @cupidilla/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @cupidilla/web
